scope: Newest-first ME5 Miraidon Photon Cord and identical Mega promo printing. Artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.facts: M5 Miraidon120HP, Photon Cord moves up to2 Basic Lightning from self to one own Bench when Active KO by opposing Pokemon attack damage; Thunder90 self30. HTML strips Lightning icon; local bilingual and FAQ explicit Lightning.
Direct official FAQ: opponent Cranidos Push Down damage KO triggers; own Thunder recoil KO does not; Mega Darkrai Abyss Eye direct-effect KO does not.
Official Piloswine Push Down FAQ explicitly describes forced switch of damage-KO Froslass to Bench before its KO reaction still applies.

evidence.name: Photon Cord
evidence.textEn: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move up to 2 Basic <sprite name="lightning" tint=1> Energy cards from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
evidence.textZh: 这只宝可梦在战斗场上受到对手的宝可梦的招式的伤害而昏厥时，选择最多2张这只宝可梦身上附着的「基本<sprite name="lightning" tint=1>能量」，转附于1只备战宝可梦身上。
